diagnostics.message: aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer points the scheduled rule at aws_lambda_function.syncer, but the resource-based policy that grants events.amazonaws.com permission to invoke the function (aws_lambda_permission.syncer) is created independently. Until that permission exists, the rule's invocations are rejected. Add depends_on = [aws_lambda_permission.syncer] to aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer, mirroring the notification->permission ordering already used for the S3 trigger path (aws_s3_bucket_notification.on_deploy depends on aws_lambda_permission.on_deploy).
